test.header: English Placement Test – Discover Your True Level

l1.content: Get a reliable evaluation of your current English level, based on internationally recognized standards (CEFR: A0 to C2).

l2.content: No more wasting time on lessons that are too easy or too hard. With your real level defined, your learning becomes faster and more effective.

l3.content: After finishing the test, you’ll receive tailored recommendations to help you focus on the areas you need the most.

l4.content: Whether you want to study abroad, apply for a job, or simply communicate better, knowing your level gives you the confidence to move forward.

l1.content: Around 15–20 minutes. Short enough to stay focused, long enough to measure your skills effectively.

l2.content: Multiple-choice questions covering grammar, vocabulary, and reading comprehension.

l3.content: Get your score instantly, along with your CEFR level (A0–C2).

l4.content: Receive recommendations on which courses, exercises, or lessons fit your level best.

l1.content: You are just starting out. Don’t worry — everyone begins here.

l2.content: You can use simple phrases and understand very basic expressions.

l3.content: You can handle everyday conversations on familiar topics.

l4.content: You can communicate about common subjects and understand longer texts.

l5.content: You can communicate about common subjects and understand longer texts.

l6.content: You are confident and fluent in most academic, social, or professional situations.

l7.content: You understand nearly everything with ease and express yourself naturally.

part5.l1: Take the test in a quiet place without distractions.
part5.l2: Don’t guess — if you don’t know the answer, select “I don’t know”. This makes your result more accurate.
part5.l3: Be honest — the goal is not a perfect score, but a true reflection of your level.
part5.l4: Relax and enjoy the process. Think of it as the first step toward your success in learning English.

part6.l1: Your English learning journey starts here. In just a few minutes, you’ll know your exact level and how to improve step by step.
part6.l2: 👉 Click the button below and start your test now!

test.text1: Welcome to our English Placement Test – the smartest way to find out exactly where you stand on your language learning journey. Whether you are a complete beginner, an intermediate learner, or an advanced speaker, this test will give you a clear picture of your skills and help you plan your next steps with confidence.
test.text2: Learning a language is like building a house: without knowing your foundation, you can’t build the right structure on top. That’s why a placement test is essential — it shows you your strengths, weaknesses, and the best path forward.
